Cross-species hybridization, gene editing, species creation... Every living thing in the universe is fair game for the Life Sciences Institute. There used to be a joke passed around among the staff: When you walk past a darkened laboratory, you never know whether the one opening the door next will be the researcher... or the research subject. Among the many widely circulated rumors and legends, the head of the Technology Department, Yabuli, has always been one of the central figures. As an elusive bigshot, everyone's heard her name, yet precious few know what the major experiment she spearheads actually entails. People gaze toward the core focus of the Life Sciences Institute with a mix of awe and trepidation, and every violent tremor that erupts from within sparks a fresh wave of feverish speculation. The Life Sciences Institute never responds to such questions. Beneath the surface, undercurrents churn, while researchers contribute their ruminations day after day.
